This is a normal phenomenon and does not affect the normal use of the machine. Yellowing: To ensure good conductivity of the charging electrodes, a silver plating process is used on the surface. At a certain temperature, silver oxide (Ag₂O) will form, which is brownish-black. The electric arc and heat during charging will promote this reaction. This is a normal phenomenon and does not affect the normal use of the machine.

q: The user feels that the hot water does not reach 70 degrees and feels that it is not hot./ Why don't you have hot water to wash rags? Why isn't it hot?
a: X40 Ultra uses 70 degrees of hot water for rag cleaning, in the process of cold water heating, it takes a certain amount of time, wash rag drying will also produce a certain amount of heat loss it, when the water tank is not enough water, the device will not heat for the safety of use.

q: The video can't be opened, how to solve it?
a: Suggest that you can switch your phone's network from WIFI to 4G and then open the video to see, you can also try to find your account out to re-login, open the video again to see it, if it still does not work, you can try to uninstall the APP, re-download the APP, if all do not work, you can provide your account ID, our side will help you feedback as soon as possible R & D to help you.

q: The water for washing mop is not hot.
a:
During the process of heating the base station with cold water, a certain amount of time is required. When cleaning the mop, a portion of cold water is released before hot water is discharged. Therefore, it is not necessary to have hot water just after washing the mop. The water temperature of 70 ° C was measured in our laboratory testing environment, and the specific outlet temperature is also related to the room temperature at your home. q: The water tank is found dirty when unpacking.

q: There is a small amount of water left in the newly bought cleaning dock/water tank.

q: Ultrasonic carpet recognition is invalid/it is obviously a carpet. Why did the machine go up and didn't recognize it?
a: Ultrasonic fails to identify the carpet in time, which has a certain relationship with the carpet material and color. for example, black carpet, or crawl mat and so on, have a certain impact on the ultrasonic. It'srecommended you can set the No-Go zone or add the carpet area (map editing - carpet editing - add carpet) to develop a different sweeping program for the current ground.

q: Voice Assistant cannot wake up.
a:
If the voice assistant can't wake up the robot, you can check it according to the following:
1. Confirm whether your robot is turned on the voice assistant function, you can check whether the switch is turned on in the APP - Enter Robot - Settings - Voice Assistant page.
2. When waking up the device, you need to say the words "OK，Dreame" accurately, clearly and evenly.

5. Do not put stickers on the top cover of LDS, it will block the voice receiving microphone and cannot wake up the robot normally.
6. After checking that the firmware is the latest version, it is recommended that you try shutting down and restarting the robot.

q: Voice prompt: Laser sensor abnormal/LDS abnormal
a:
【Abnormal laser sensor】
1. Confirm whether the LDS component is stuck by foreign objects and cannot rotate. Gently move the LDS to try.
2. It is necessary to confirm whether the front, back, left, and right sides of the LDS cover can be gently moved.

q: What if AI mistakenly identifies it?/ What if the number of obstacles is inconsistent?
a:
AI misidentification can be divided into two situations.
1. The obstacles displayed on the map are different from the actual number.
In order to ensure the cleanliness and clarity of the APP map, the system defaults to setting obstacles of the same type that are too close. Although they are all recognized, only one icon is displayed on the map. Please do not worry, the robot will avoid all obstacles.
2. If the obstacles displayed on the map are different from the actual types.
(1) Firstly, different light intensities may affect the accuracy of obstacle recognition. Please ensure that there is sufficient light during the AI recognition process, and the machine will update the obstacle type in real-time the next time it passes by the obstacle.
(2) There are various forms of obstacles in the home environment, which may cause AI recognition errors. However, our robots will become increasingly intelligent through continuous learning and optimization. We suggest that you regularly check and update the firmware version.

q: What if the clean water tank is loose after being buckled?
a:
How to deal with the loose water tank after the buckle is closed?
We're very sorry for the inconvenience, the clean water tank buckle loose, please you can manually press the clean water tank buckle cover to ensure the installation in place.

q: What if the Dreame robot fail to relocate itself?
a:
After the robot prompts that the positioning failed, if the base station has not moved, you can put the robot back to the base station in time, and the robot will automatically restore the map. If the map fails to restore, you can start cleaning again.Once the cleaning is complete, the map will be saved after automatic recharging.
If the location of the base station has moved, or the surrounding environment has changed greatly, the robot will have a certain probability of failure to locate.If the ground is wet and the drive wheel slips or the robot is trapped, it may fail to locate; you can check according to the specific usage.
For a better user experience, it is recommended not to follow the robot closely when the robot is working. Use the minimum water output to mop the floor when the ground is wet or on tiles. Before the robot works, you can pack up scattered objects, wires and other items, and you can also enable functions such as virtual walls/restricted areas to avoid the robot being trapped.
If you have saved multiple maps, when the robot enters the corresponding map, the APP needs to switch to the corresponding map, otherwise it will cause the positioning failure.

q: What if the light and thin floor mat cannot be easily identified and may curl up?
a: You floor mat cannot attach well to the ground. If the floor is made of ceramic tiles and the machine has a high suction force, it may be rolled up. We suggest that you manually set up a carpet area [Map Management - Carpet Editing - Add Carpet]. Alternatively, setting cleaning restricted area [map management - restricted area/virtual wall - restricted area] can also fix the floor mat to avoid getting entangled in the robot and affecting its normal operation.

q: What if the map is  overlapped or distorted?
a:
Sorry for the inconvenience, you can put the machine back to the base station and restart it first to see if you can restore the original map, if it still doesn't work, you can click the "Map Management" icon and click Restore Map to restore the normal square map.
To avoid similar problems, please help to exclude the following situations.
1. whether the room layout and furniture placement are similar.
2. whether the cleaning process is stuck (check whether the drive wheel is entangled with foreign objects).
3. if the water level is set too large, the cleaning fluid is used in excess, and the machine slips and spins in place when in use can also cause the map to be abnormal.
4. confirm whether the machine's LDS rotation is normal, you can also try to lightly touch the upper cover of the LDS sensor to check whether the rebound is normal.

q: What if the mop adsorbs rust at home and causes wear on the positioning column?
a: Our mop pad holder is made of plastic material, and the bottom magnetic suction structure will absorb the rust in your home. When the robot rotates at high speed inside the base station, scraping and flushing may cause wear on the positioning column, which does not affect the normal use of the machine.

q: What if the mop pad installation fails?
a:
We're very sorry for the inconvenience, you can check according to the following.
1. Check whether the mopping mop of our robot on the washboard.
2. Check whether there is a foreign body in the base station's washboard, it is recommended to remove the foreign body, wipe clean the cleaning plate.
3. If the mop pads are in the washboard, you can let the robot try to install.

q: What if the robot charges abnormally?
a:
1. Suggest that you can give priority to check whether the base station is successfully energized state, confirm whether the base power cable both ends have been inserted.
2. Subsequently check whether the robot base and host charging piece is dusty, dusty will appear charging anomalies, please wipe and then use it.
3. Confirm whether the robot is docked accurately, you can try to manually place the machine in front of the base station, the robot will trigger the automatic back-charging docking accurate.

q: What if the robot fails to collect dust?
a:
We suggest that you follow the following steps to take a look.
1. It is necessary to cover the dust cover of the dust collection bin and pack the dust bag properly when the base station is powered on and performing dust collection work.
2. Please check if the dust bag is full. If it is full, replace it and perform the dust collection again.
3. Check if the dust collection ports of the robot, base station and the dust box are blocked. Please clean them before dust collection.
4. Please check if the dust collection button on the app is turned off. Please try again after turning it on. If the robot is in 'Do Not Disturb'  Mode, it will not execute the dust collection command. It is necessary to turn off or change the Do Not Disturb time period.
5. Check if the window at the charging electrode is dirty and may not be able to transmit signals. Please clean it with a dry tissue before attempting again.
6. If there is a large amount of dust and dirt in the home, it is recommended to set up high-frequency dust collection.

q: What if the robot go up the floor carpet when mopping?
a:
1. Our robot factory default on carpet identification switch, will automatically identify the carpet material, the host will be on the carpet, will lift the mop, increase suction, is a normal phenomenon.
2. If you want the robot not on the carpet, you can choose to avoid the carpet in the APP.
3. Our robot also has a function of dismantling the mop on the carpet, you can first drag all the areas that are not carpet, and then return to the base station to dismantle the mop on the carpet for cleaning.
4. If the carpet recognition is not accurate, you can turn off the carpet recognition, manually set the mopping prohibited areas in the map settings, in the process of mopping will bypass the prohibited areas and not go to the carpet.

q: What if the robot's cover feels hot?
a: Our device uses a high computing power platform chip, compared to the previous will be easier to heat up, but there is absolutely no safety problems, you can rest assured that the use.

q: What if the threshold still fails to cross the obstacle after use?
a: If your threshold height, higher than about 22mm, the threshold can't normal help the robot climb threshold, you need to prepare the climbing pad to assist climbing.

q: What if there is dust leakage at the dust collection port?
a: We're sorry for the inconvenience caused. We suggest that you prioritize checking if the dust bag and dust box are full, and check if there are any foreign objects blocking the dust collection ports. If the dust bag/dust box is full, we suggest that you replace the dust bag or use the immediate dust collection function in a timely manner. After using it for a period of time, if you find that the dirt in the dust box cannot be collected, you need to manually clean it in a timely manner. (ps: It needs to be fully dried.)

q: What is the difference between daily mode and ultimate mode in CleanGenius?
a:
Use daily mode for light pollution, and ultimate mode for heavy pollution.
Daily mode is more water-saving, while Ultimate mode is cleaner.
Daily mode: Support dirt detection and secondary cleaning of heavily contaminated areas after global cleaning is completed. Suitable for daily household cleaning and maintenance, efficient and worry free.
Extreme mode: Support dirt detection, and once dirt is detected, the mop will be washed once more. At the same time, targeted secondary cleaning of dirty areas will be carried out after completing the current task. The whole house is more densely arched, and the cleaning speed is slower. Areas such as tables and chairs that are prone to dirt will be heavily cleaned; Deep cleaning suitable for sweeping. It is recommended that you enable resume cleaning first and then use this mode.

q: What is the function of threshold?
a: This vacuum in order to be able to assist the threshold or sliding door slide in your home to  efficiently cross the barrier, set the function of virtual slide in the APP (map editing - threshold - add a threshold), this function is not recommended to be placed in the stairway and other easy to fall areas to use.

q: What is the reason for the distance from the wall when the robot is cleaning along the edge?
a:
1. Our robot is equipped with edge sensors, which maintain a certain distance from the wall during edge cleaning, which is a normal phenomenon.
2. Our robot supports intelligent dynamic edge bonding function. After the dynamic edge bonding function is enabled, the edge sensor on the right side of the body detects the edge status, shortens the forward distance, increases the twisting motion of the body, covers the areas that were missed along the original straight edge, and reduces white space on the wall edge.

q: What is the reason for the small aperture with green light when using the video function?
a: This is the inverted image of the machine AI lens, similar to the object placed inside the car, there will be a inverted image projected onto the front window glass it, this is not affected by the normal use of your robot.

q: What should I do if I can't be found by summoning the robot to cleaning (Come to clean; 你好, 追觅, come to me and mop the floor)
a:
1. Make sure that the robot is in the same room as you and that you can see it in your line of sight.
2. Try to keep the distance with the robot within 5m for voice controlling.
Notes:
①When the robot is under the sofa and bed which has a large area of obstruction on the top of it, the AI camera may not be able to recognize you, resulting in a lower success rate of summoning cleaning.
②When there are more obstacles between the robot and you, the AI camera may not be able to recognize you due to the obstacles, resulting in a lower success rate of summoning cleaning.

q: What should I do if the paper remains in the dust collection duct during dust collection?
a: We're sorry for the inconvenience caused. If there are too many paper pieces in your dust box, it can be easily adsorbed by static electricity, resulting in a very small amount remaining in the air duct. However, it does not affect your normal use. You can wait for the next dust collection to collect them together with other garbage. You can also choose to adjust the dust collection mode to high frequency dust collection, then garbage will not be left.

q: What should I do when the base fails to pump wastewater into the used tank or the water level in the washboard is abnormal?
a:
The abnormal water level of the cleaning tray is closely related to the sealing performance of the robot's sewage tank. It is recommended that you operate according to the following steps to ensure the sealing performance during sewage pumping.
1. Take out the waste tank to check whether the sealing ring is deformed or not installed properly, if so, reset the sealing ring manually. If the waste tank is broken, please contact customer service.
2. Make sure the waste tank is normal. Then close the waste tank cover, put the waste tank back, and press the tank to make it installed in place.
3. Press the clips on both sides of the washboard to take it out. Pour out the wastewater, and check whether the filter is clogged, if so, clean it.
4. Wipe off the water left in the base with a dry cloth, install the washboard, and fasten the clips on both sides of the washboard.
5. Clean the mop pad first. If the error remains, please contact customer service.

q: When does the base station light go out?
a: When the robot is fully charged in the base station for ten minutes, the base station light will automatically turn off (except during tasks). But if your robot is in no disturbe mode, the robot light will go out after 30 seconds, and the base station light will also go out.

q: When entering video surveillance and using voice calls, what should I do if the app flashes or prompts "Voice occupied"?
a:
We're very sorry for the inconvenience caused. Generally, this situation occurs during voice calls because the previous command did not end. You can try the following.
1. It is recommended to press and hold the power button in the middle of the host for 3S to shut down and restart the robot when it is not on the base station (not in a charging state)
2. (There will be a brief offline time when the power is turned off and restarted) After the network returns to normal, enter the APP and try the voice call function.

q: When I opened the box, I found debris like hair.
a: Because most of our robots are injection molding material, and the use of PE bag packaging, outside the set of yellow board box, dust or debris of yellow board box falling behind, will be adsorpted on the PE bag or the machine. We're sorry to give you a bad experience!

q: When the carpet recognition function is turned on, the carpet will still be wet.
a:
Our robot supports carpet identification, the default is turn on state, when the robot on the carpet only sweeping action, suction enhanced, mop for lifting. Due to the limited lifting height of the wipe, the height from the ground after lifting 7mm is about 5mm,  If the carpet is thick, there is also the possibility of lightly rubbed by the mop. 
If you want the robot with the mop not go on the carpet, you can choose to avoid the carpet in the APP. You can also set the APP to dismantle the mop on the carpet function, you can first drag all not carpet area, and then return to the base station to dismantle the mop on the carpet for cleaning, if you do not want the robot on the carpet, then you can also choose to use the cleaning prohibited area, prohibit the robot to enter.
Tip: shaggy carpet with a thickness of 22mm or more may be identified by the line laser as an obstacle and avoid.

q: When will the water supply and drainage be implemented? How to achieve the method of water supply and drainage?
a: Our robot supports the additional selection of water supply and drainage modules. Please rest assured that our installation technician will come to your doorstep to help install the water supply and drainage modules .(Please first confirm that your home environment is suitable for installing the water supply and drainage modules)

q: Why are side brushes prone to deformation?
a: Our side brush is made of nylon bristles. If there are curling problems during packaging or daily cleaning, you can use hot water to heat it up and then use a tool to remove it. The bristles can be smoothed straight.

q: Why are there more carpets displayed on the app than the actual ones?Why hasn't the added carpet been cleaned near?
a: This is a normal phenomenon. Our app makes the carpet editing function more convenient to operate, in order to make the carpet display more beautiful and provide you with a more aesthetically designed app experience. Therefore, the area adjacent to the carpet will also be included, and the display will be larger than the actual carpet. Our robot will switch the vacuuming, mopping mode according to the actual ground conditions when vacuuming and mopping. It will never miss mopping any ground and you can use it with confidence.

q: Why can mops easily fall off?
a: We suggest that you observe the fit of the mop on the mop pad holder before using it. If the mop cannot be properly applied or is uneven after multiple uses, you need to replace it with a new one in a timely manner.

q: Why can robots avoid carpets during cleaning, but not during backwashing/recharging?
a: After we have set up the avoidance carpet, the robot can avoid the carpet while working, but cannot perform avoidance carpet during backwashing/recharging. You can use the APP to set the "mopping prohibited area" to prevent the robot from using the carpet in mopping mode.

q: Why can't I reach the designated room for cleaning when voice control is used?（Such as cleaning living room)
a:
1. When you say "Go to the living room to clean", the "living room" in the voice command refers to the map information you named on the APP map, which may not be the actual location of the room in your home.
2. If the robot does not reach the room you want it to clean, please go to APP - Map Management - Map Edit to check if the room is named correctly.
3. Currently, only the existing room names are supported by voice to perform room cleaning, the specific supported rooms can be viewed in APP - Map Management - Map Edit - Rename.

q: Why can't I use the function you advertised?(Such as clean the table)
a:
1. Some functions are not implemented when the product is listed, and need to be used through subsequent OTA upgrades.
2. Check the version information and upgrade to the latest firmware version: Check APP - Robot Settings - Settings - Firmware Upgrade to see if the host has a firmware update.

q: Why can't the instructions I gave to the robot be executed correctly?
a:
If your voice command is not recognized, you can check the following list:
1. Our robot needs to recognize voice commands to perform its work. Please confirm if your voice commands are in the list of supported voice skills and enter the "⋮" in the top right corner of the device  - Voice Assistant - "See what else to say" to view.
2. If you speak too quickly during wake-up, the robot may not recognize it. Please maintain accurate, clear, and uniform voice when issuing commands to ensure that you can correctly recognize the voice commands.
3. If there is relatively loud noise around the host or you are far from the host, the voice may not be able to recognize voice commands. You can check whether the voice conversation record is correct in the APP. If it is not correct, we suggest you increase the volume and try it out.
4. If the voice conversation record is correct and in the list of supported voice skills, but the robot still cannot recognize it, please let us know the voice command you responded to, and I will provide feedback to our engineers for optimization as soon as possible. Thank you for your support.

q: Why can't you clean the floor while listening to music?
a: At present, the robot does not support playing music. The robot in the implementation of cleaning work, mopping disk rotation, sweeping suction will produce noise, and then the implementation of music playback experience is poor.

q: Why didn't the app prompt for a lack of water when there was no water during the last backwash?
a: In order to ensure that the robot can complete the current cleaning task, the clean water tank will complete the cleaning work on the last backwash of the mop when there is no water. After the cleaning task is completed, there will be a water shortage prompt. If there is no water to clean the mop for the first time, there will also be a water shortage warning. PS: You can manually click to clean it once on the APP after adding water.

q: Why do robots miss vacuuming and mopping table legs, sofa legs?
a: Our robot adopts the world's first bionic mechanical arm and the strategy of wiping edges and corners with mops. The existing robots on the market can not clean the table and chair legs to the edge. You can adjust to the ultimate cleaning mode in the APP, which will focus on cleaning the table and chair legs in your home.

q: Why do robots scratch the ground?
a: Our robot uses a mop made of Mantianxing composite material, with nylon side brush and soft rubber drive wheels. These materials will not scratch your floor. Could you please check if there are any hard objects sucked into the bottom of your robot? If there are sharp objects at the bottom of the robot, there may be a risk of damaging the floor.

q: Why does particle recognition fail/why does it didn't open the maximum suction when encountering large particles? /Why is the particulate missed to clean?
a: If it is a small amount of particles, such as a small amount of cat litter and so on, the AI recognition has a certain degree of difficulty, we recommend that you can manually turn on the maximum suction power to deep clean the floor.

q: Why does self-cleaning sewage flow into the cleaning tray and cannot be sucked clean?
a: We are sorry for the inconvenience caused. The principle of our sewage pumping is using an air pump, similar to using a thick straw to drink milk tea. In the end, there will always be residues that cannot be sucked completely and fall into the bottom of the cup. If you are in self-cleaning mode, you can wipe it with a mop normally and install a cleaning plate for use. If you are in the cleaning mop mode, when the mop is dried, it will also dry off this part of the water stains.

q: Why does the App indicates that the robot is offline？
a:
We suggest you investigate the following possible situations.
1. When the robot is turned off, the APP cannot connect to the robot.
2. The online and offline status changes of the robot are related to the strength of the network signal at the location where the robot is located. If the network signal at the location where the robot is located is weak or unstable, the robot will be offline.
3. There is no internet connection with your Wi-Fi.

You can take a look at the following solutions.
1. Check whether the robot is in a shutdown state. If it is in a shutdown state, please press and hold the power key of the robot to turn it on, and then reconfigure the network.
2. Offline during normal operation of the robot will not affect the it to continue to complete the previous cleaning task. When the network signal is better, the robot will automatically return to the online state.
3. You can add or reset the network to the robot, and put the router close to the robot to assign the network to the robot.
4. Check whether the Wi-Fi works normally. If the Wi-Fi is abnormal, repair the it in time, and then configure the network again.
5. Please check whether the 5G preference is selected in the distribution network settings of the robot, and you need to turn off this setting.

q: Why does the base station leak water?
Why does the cleaning tray make a strange noise when washing mops?
a: I'm very sorry for the bad experience you had. The cleaning of the base station adopts an active dual scraping arm design, and the frame structure of the cleaning disc is not completely in contact with the bottom, leaving a certain amount of space for the scraping strip to move. With this space, the cleaning cloth will be cleaner. In addition, if there are foreign objects entangled at the roller of your cleaning disc, you can disassemble the roller for cleaning~

q: Why does the drive wheel leak oil?
a: We're very sorry for any inconvenience caused. Our drive wheels come with a lubrication design and there may be lubricating oil inside, which may have overflowed. Please wipe it clean and it will not affect normal use. If you have any further questions, please contact us again.

q: Why does the home look dirty in the CleanGenius mode (daily+ultimate mode), but there is no secondary cleaning?
a: Our robot automatically determines whether the mop has been cleaned thoroughly, and then determines whether the corresponding cleaned area is clean. When you see some areas that are dirty, but there is no secondary cleaning, it is possible that the current mop is clean. However, considering the lifespan of our robot's clean water tank, the maximum number of secondary cleaning in a single task is one, and there will be no cleaning three times. You can perform selected area cleaning.

q: Why does the map always fail to load or the display content of the map is missing? (Including trajectory lines, custom cleaning settings, AI recognition icons)
a:
The map cannot be loaded due to the following reasons. Could you please investigate it.
1. It is recommended to place the robot in a location with good WIFI signals, as it has a certain relationship with the home network and servers.
2. It is related to the strength of the network signal of the robot's location. If the network signal of the robot's location is weak or unstable, the robot may experience slow map loading. 
You can try:

IOS users: Clear cache in the general settings of the DeramehomeApp settings page.
Android users: After entering the system settings, click on Application Management, find the DeramehomeApp, and clear the cache in the storage.

q: Why does the mop fall off easily when the robot works?
a: Very sorry for the inconvenience, when the machine over the carpet, threshold, small steps, the mop pad may be stuck off, resulting in the mop pad fall, you can set the mopping prohibited area to avoid the sweeper with mop into. And try to organize the ground power cord before sweeping, to prevent tangling and cause the mop pad to fall off.

q: Why does the mop holder fall into the base station?
a: When the robot takes it from the base station, it may cause the mop pad holder to get stuck. It is recommended that you use the APP to operate the robot, and the robot will automatically exit the base station. When you want the robot to return to the base station, use the robot recharge button to return the robot to the base station to avoid the mop pad holder getting stuck in the base station.

q: Why does the robot broadcast 'path blocked' when it reaches the designated position without obstacles?
a:
Could you please check if there are any overlapping or skewed maps in the app? If there are any, please restore them to a normal square map or rebuild the map and then observe again.

q: Why does the robot dock to the base station secondly before start cleaning?
a: Before the robot starts cleaning tasks, will self-test charging pole piece, docking port, automatic replenishment port docking is normal to ensure that the host can be normal replenishment, if there is a deviation in the docking, the robot will back off the base and then make the second docking, is a normal phenomenon, please rest assured that the use.

q: Why does the robot dock to the base station secondly when return to charge or wash mop pad?
a:
1. The robot needs to ensure that the charging pole piece, docking port, automatic water refill port are in place, there are high precision requirements, the robot will automatically correct the charging route according to the base signal, in the case of imperfect docking, back off the base and make thesecond docking, this is a normal phenomenon. Please ensure that the base stationvis placed on the horizontal ground, the base and no water residue near the base to avoid slippage.
2. q: Maps are overlaid or messed up

a: We are very sorry for the inconvenience. q: Quick map building is slow/the robot crashes randomly/suddenly retreats quickly during operation/the flat ground alarm robot tilts and the robot is trapped

a: In order to ensure that the robot can complete the current cleaning task, when there is no water in the clean water tank, the cleaning work will be completed by backwashing the rag for the last time. q: Will turning on a video infringe on my privacy?
a: Our products are designed to ensure firmware security and network security at the system level: 1. The release version closes the debugging serial port by default 2. Anti-flash, with the function of secure firmware, only firmware with the same secret key can be burned successfully; 3. Secure startup, file system verification, uboot startup will verify the file system, and only if the certificates are consistent can the computer be booted normally; 4. The debugging button is turned off during the uboot startup phase, and you cannot enter the system through the button during startup; Network security level: 1. Anti-injection check: prevent external attack commands from being transmitted through network communication 2. Connection with the server: identity authentication + TLSv1.3 encrypted communication 3. Photography: locally encrypted by AES256 + random key, uploaded to cloud storage, key passed The encrypted channel is sent to the APP 5. Video transmission: Directly pushed to the Agora server through the Agora SDK 6. Access code: Set by the user, the APP transmits it to the device through the encrypted channel, and the device stores it in a secure storage area

1. Please confirm whether the breakpoint resume switch is turned on.
2. The breakpoint resume function only takes effect in the automatic working mode and does not trigger breakpoint resume during the Do not disturb mode time.
3. Confirm whether the fault alarm is triggered when the robot is charging. If there is a fault, the breakpoint continuation scan will not be triggered.
4. Confirm whether the robot has been restarted or reset after triggering the resume scan from the breakpoint.

q: The robot cannot be charged.
a:
1. Possible cause: The charging dock is not powered on. Please make sure that both ends of the power cord of the charging dock and the base station are properly plugged in.
2. Possible cause: Poor contact between the spring piece of the charging dock and the charging contact piece of the main unit. Please cut off the power first and then clean the contact pieces, or adjust the contact position.

q: The robot cannot be turned on.
a:
Reasons for failure to boot up:
An error occurred inside the robot system, causing the robot's buttons to fail.
2. The robot cannot be turned on due to insufficient battery power. When encountering such a situation, please first place the robot into the base station or charging dock, charge it for a period of time, then take out the robot and try to turn it on.
3. If the robot still fails to power on after charging, please restore its factory Settings. If the problem persists, please contact the after-sales customer service.

q: The robot couldn't find the charging dock or the base station
a:
There are generally the following situations where robots cannot find charging stations or base stations:
1. The charging dock or base station is disconnected from power or moved by humans. In such cases, please connect the charging dock or base station to the power supply and return it to its original position.
2. There are obstacles on the charging dock or base station tray and the surrounding ground. When encountering such situations, please clear the obstacles in time.
3. The robot gets trapped or gives an alarm during the cleaning process. In such cases, please manually place the robot back on the charging dock or base station.
4. The ground where the charging dock or base station is located is uneven. In such cases, please place the charging dock or base station on a flat ground.
5. System failure. Place the robot 1 meter in front of the charging dock or base station, and click the "Recall" button of the charging dock or base station. If it cannot be returned to the charging dock or base station, please contact after-sales service for handling.

q: The robot did not continue cleaning after recharging
a:
1. The robot may be in the Do Not Disturb mode. In this mode, the robot will not start to continue scanning.
2. Manual recharging or moving the robot back to the charging dock, in this case the robot will not continue scanning either.

q: The robot doesn't work at the appointed time
a: When such problems occur, it might be due to insufficient battery power of the machine. Only when the battery power exceeds 15% will the machine perform the scheduled scheduled cleaning.

q: The robot fails to clean thoroughly or its cleaning performance declines
a:
1. The dust box is full and needs to be cleaned. Models with central dust collection can be automatically cleaned and generally do not have such problems.
2. The filter screen is clogged and needs to be cleaned.
3. The main brush is entangled with foreign objects and needs to be cleaned.
4. The suction gear setting is too low. Please increase the gear parameter.

q: The robot indicates that foreign objects are entangling the roller brush
a:
1. Please first remove the cover plate of the roller brush, then take out the roller brush and clean up any entanglement on it.
2.After cleaning, please reinstall the roller brush and check if it rotates smoothly by hand.
3. When reinstalling the roller brush, make sure that the cover plate is securely fastened around it.

q: The robot missed scanning a certain area
a:
1. The robot cannot enter narrow Spaces. The space it can enter needs to be 2cm wider on both sides of the body.
2. For machines with ultrasonic carpet recognition, if a carpet is detected at the door during mopping mode, it will prevent you from entering the room for cleaning. Please remove the carpet and try again.

q: The robot mop has an unpleasant smell
a:
The robot mop has an unpleasant smell.
Possible causes: The home environment is damp, or the mop has not been dried, and it has not been used for a long time, which has led to mold.
2. Daily use: After using the mopping mode, please clean the mop and place it in a dry and well-ventilated environment to dry.

q: The robot recharge always fails
a:
1. There might be many obstacles near the charging dock and base station. Please clear the nearby obstacles or place the charging dock and base station in an open area.
2. It's possible that the robot is too far from the charging dock. In such cases, please place the robot back near the charging dock and then try to recharge it.
3. Daily cleaning: Ensure that the robot departs from the base station or the charging dock to guarantee that the map accurately locates the charging position.
4. Check if the charging dock is charged.
5. Check if there are any crooked or overlapping images on the clean map within the APP. If such situations occur, please create a new map.

q: The robot repeatedly cleans a certain area
a:
1. If the cleaning time is less than 10 minutes, a secondary cleaning will be carried out (except for area cleaning).
2. If the map is duplicated, there is a probability that it may cause abnormal robot positioning and lead to repeated cleaning. In such cases, please recreate the map or restore it.

q: The robot was connected to the network and then went offline
a:

2. During the cleaning process, if the local network signal of the robot is poor, it may go offline.
3. If the robot is shut down with low power outside the charging dock, it will go offline.

q: The robot's cleaning route is in a mess
a:
The first mapping process
During the mapping process, robots need to explore and learn the indoor terrain environment, thus requiring more tortuous routes to cover more regional terrains. After the map is successfully saved, the subsequent cleaning routes will return to normal.

Daily usage process
In daily use, if your robot experiences route confusion, please check the following items:
Before cleaning: You can store and organize the scattered items on the floor, such as drag boards, toys, slippers, etc., to avoid frequent collisions during the cleaning process, which may cause confusion in the cleaning route.
2. Cleaning in progress: If there are foreign objects stuck, dust accumulated or oil adhering to the bottom drive wheels, please clean them in time to prevent abnormal movements of the robot during movement.
3. During cleaning: If the robot collides multiple times during the cleaning process, it will briefly move along the edge and then resume the bow-shaped cleaning.
4. High frequency: If the robot cleaning frequently experiences route confusion, you need to upgrade the robot's firmware to the latest version, reset the map, and start building the map again.

q: The robot's mapping is incomplete or a certain area is omitted

If there are items at the door of the room or the door is not fully opened, when the robot's lidar scans the entrance, it will misjudge it as impossible to pass and give up entering the area.
2. During the process of scanning and mapping, if a person or pet walks around the robot, it may mislead the robot's environmental scanning results, resulting in incomplete mapping.

q: What causes the main unit to consume power quickly during cleaning?

After the main unit is fully charged and left for a relatively long time, there may be a rapid drop in battery power in the first few minutes of cleaning, which is a normal phenomenon. The battery power consumption will return to normal after a few minutes.

a: After L10s Ultra is charged and stored for a long time, it is normal for the battery to drop quickly in the first few minutes during cleaning. After this, the power consumption will return to normal. The battery will also drop faster in Turbo mode.

q: Why does the Dreame D10s Pro Pro fail to charge?
a: Please clean the charging interface of the Base and the robot if there is any dust on it, as dust may result in charging failure.

q: Why does the Dreame L10s Ultra fail to relocate itself?
a: After the machine prompts that the positioning failed, if the base station has not moved, you can put the robot back to the base station in time, and the robot will automatically restore the map. If the map fails to restore, you can start cleaning again.Once the cleaning is complete, the map will be saved after automatic recharging. If the location of the base station has moved, or the surrounding environment has changed greatly, the robot will have a certain probability of failure to locate.If the ground is wet and the drive wheel slips or the robot is trapped, it may fail to locate; you can check according to the specific usage. For a better user experience, it is recommended not to follow the robot closely when the robot is working. Use the minimum water output to mop the floor when the ground is wet or on tiles. Before the it works, you can pack up scattered objects, wires and other items, and you can also enable functions such as virtual walls/restricted areas to avoid the robot being trapped. If you have saved multiple maps, when the robot enters the corresponding map, the APP needs to switch to the corresponding map, otherwise it will cause the positioning failure.

q: Why does the L10s Ultra use a single-sided brush instead of a double-sided brush?
a: The L10s Ultra uses a single-side brush + main brush for cleaning. The single-side brush is mainly responsible for cleaning the garbage near the walls and furniture edges. Compared with the double-sided brush, it is easy to blow up the garbage when cleaning, and the double-sided brush is more likely to be entangled on the carpet.

q: Why does the robot fail to do schedule clean?
a: It might be caused by the low battery level. The scheduled clean only works when the battery level is higher than 15%.

q: Why does the robot fail to upgrade the firmware?
a:
Please kindly check the network connection and do the firmware upgrade with a stable network connection.
Please make sure the battery is over 15% before upgrading.

q: Why is the Carpet Boost function unstable?
a: This function is still the beta version. Using the robot on the shorter carpet might cause the function failure.

q: Why is the map different than before? What should I do if the map is distorted, inclined, or overlapped?
a:
The map is distorted or overlapped:
Make sure the map is saved successfully, which means the parted sections are shown in the map, and the area cleaning can work properly.
Turn off the power and restart the robot vacuum. Then manually place the robot vacuum to the charging base and try to restore the map. If the restoration fails, replace the charging base position and redo the mapping.
Recommendations:
1.Properly place the base against the wall by making sure the open space beside the base should be at least 0.5m, and there are no obstacles 1m from the front of the base.
2.While the robot vacuum is working, please do not manually move the machine.
3.Strong light or highly reflective situations might cause the malfunction of the mapping. 
4.We recommend closing the curtain or finding another time when the light is not so strong to clean. For highly reflective surfaces, it’s better to cover 15cm from the bottom of the surface while cleaning.
Users can reset the mapping, and the robot will remap during its next cleaning.
5. Regularly check and clean the navigation sensors with a soft cloth or tissue.

q: How should I upgrade the firmware of the robot?
a: It can be done by Mi Home or Dreamehome APPs (please make sure the robot is on the Base and the battery is over 15%). The buttons on the robot will flash rapidly during the Whole process.

q: How to deal with error related to the clean water tank when doing the self-wash?
a: It is recommended that you first check whether the clean water tank is installed correctly, or whether the water volume of the clean water tank is insufficient. If it is normal, you can check it according to the following steps: 1. You can take out the clean water tank and check whether the float at the bottom of the clean water tank and the float magnet are in place. If it is lost, please contact with dreame support team. 2. When the water in the clean water tank is not enough to complete the work, an exception will be displayed. After adding enough clean water, click the sweep and drag button on the base or the start button on the App to start cleaning 3. Please put the clean water tank in place again and press it gently to ensure the accuracy of the docking between the clean water tank and the base station; 4. If the water tank still reports a fault, please unplug the power supply of the base, wait for 1 minute, plug it in again, and try again 5. If the problem still exists, please contact with dreame support team.

q: How to do the routine maintenance for the Base Station?
a: Used Water Tank 1. Remove the used water tank, open its cover and pour out the dirty water. 2. Rinse the used water tank with clean water, and use the provided cleaning brush to clean the inner wall of the used water tank. Note: The float ball in the used water tank is a movable part. Do not apply too much force when cleaning it to avoid damaging it. Charging Contacts Clean the charging contacts and the signaling area of the base station with a soft, dry cloth. Auto-empty Vents Clean the auto-empty vents of the robot and the base station with a soft, dry cloth. Cleaner Adding Inlet If the cleaner adding inlet is dirty, wipe it with a soft, dry cloth. Mop Pad Remove the mop pad from the mop pad holder to replace it.

q: How to restore to factory settings with the robot?
a: A: If robot still fails to operate normally after restarting, press and hold the reset button with a tool until hearing the voice prompt “start to restore factory settings.”

q: How to use the Do-Not-Disturb mode with the robot?
a: DND mode is enabled by default from 10:00 pm to 08:00 am. You can disable or edit DND mode with the Mi Home or Dreamehome app. The robot will stop cleaning and voice reporting during the DND period, and the power indicator is off.

q: What are the feature of Dreame L10s Ultra?
a: A fully automated base station empties the robot's dust box, cleans and dries the mop pads, adds water and cleaning solution, and more. Advanced mapping, obstacle avoidance, navigation, and automatic cleaning strategy creation using dual lasers, an RBG camera, and powerful AI. Impressive hard floor and carpet cleaning ability with up to 5,300Pa of suction pressure, automatic suction adjustment, and a brand new rubber brush that is specifically optimized for carpet cleaning. Advanced mopping ability with proactive pressure and 180RPM dual rotary mops. Customizable suction level, mop dampness, and cleaning plans via the app. Voice control supported with Alexa and Google Assistant.

q: What is the advantage of the AI Visual Sensor?
a: The advanced AI Action utilizes an RGB camera and LiDAR navigation to rapidly learn your home, tailor cleaning strategies, and auto-generate paths according to the type of obstacle, flooring, and room. Get cleaning sooner with fast mapping that generates a 3D map of your home.

q: What should I do if the dust collection is failed？
a: 1. Ensure that the base station is powered on and the dust collection work is performed, the dust cover of the dust collection bin needs to be covered and the dust bag is installed; 2. Please check whether the dust bag is full. If it is full, replace the dust bag again. 3. Check the dust collection port of the robot and the base, and whether the dust collection outlet of the dust box is blocked. Please clean it before dust collection operation. 4. Please check whether the dust collection button of the APP is turned off. If it is turned off, please turn it on and try again. 5. Check that the transparent window at the charging pole piece is dirty, and it may not be able to transmit the signal. Please clean it with a dry paper towel and try again. 6. If the amount of dust and dirt in the home is large, it is recommended to set the frequency of dust collection to be every time after cleaning.

q: What should I pay attention to before cleaning with the robot?
a: Make sure the robot is fully charged before cleaning. Tidy up the space, put away fragile items and objects on the floor before cleaning.

q: What’s the function of the line laser? How do I use it?
a: The line laser on the robot vacuum helps recognize its surroundings and obstacles, which then enables the vacuum to accurately avoid bumping and reduce the probability of entanglement, stuck and accidentally riding on small objects. The function of obstacle avoidance is turned on by default. Users can change its status manually via settings on the APP.

q: Why do the used water tank and the washborad have a bad smell?
a: 1. When the ground is dirty, it is recommended to dump and rinse the sewage tank in time after each use. 2. Regularly clean the cleaning disk. It is recommended to use the mopping function every 2~3 times to clean the cleaning disk once And the L10s Ultra is equipped with a base station self-cleaning function, you could follow the steps as below. Base station self-cleaning process: 1. Short press the Leave Button to exit the robot from the base station. 2. Manually remove the washboard on the base. 3. Long press the Leave Button for 3s to perform self-cleaning of the base station, and the clean water pump discharges water. 4. Use brush to clean the base station. 5. Press and hold the Leave Button again for 3s to pump dirty water. 6. Gently wipe the smooth cleaning plate with a rag and put the cleaning plate back. 7. Short press the main unit recharge button to let the main unit automatically return to the base station for charging.

q: Why does the robot start to clean the next zone before finishing the current one?
a: After the first mapping, Dreame L10s Ultra will clean your home by room. If this issue occurs, check the zone settings in the app and adjust the settings if any errors arise.

q: Can D10 Plus operate in the low-light environment?
a: Yes, it could.

q: Do I need to charge the D10s Pro for 16 hours for the first three tasks?
a: it is not required,please do the normal charging.

q: How should I upgrade the firmware of D10 Plus?
a: It can be done by Mi Home or Dreamehome APP(please make sure the D10 Plus is on the Base and the battery is over 15%). Two buttons on the D10 Plus will flash rapidly during the Whole process.

q: How to clean the mop of the Dreame D10 Plus?
a: 1. Press the two release clips on the side of the water tank, remove the mopping module, and pull the mop pad off the mopping module. 2. Pour out the water in the tank. Clean with only water and leave out to air dry before re-installing. Note: Do not expose the tank to the sun directly. 3. Clean the mop pad with water only and leave to air dry before re-installing. Note: • Remove the pad from the mopping module before cleaning it, and make sure dirty water does not flow back into the water outlet to avoid clogging. • For optimal performance, it is recommended to replace the mop pad every 3-6 months. 4. If slow water flow occurs, or the volume is not well-distributed, clean the air hole in the cover of the water tank.

q: How to deal with device errors of the Dreame D10s Pro?
a: Press the Power/Clean button and hold for 6 seconds to reboot.

q: How to mop those stubborn stains on the floor?
a: The D10 Plus may not be able to remove some stubborn stains on the floor while mopping. Please clean them manually.

q: How to reduce the noise during the cleaning?
a: Check if the brush is stuck with objects and clean it in time to avoid any damage caused. To reduce the noise, kindly choose the quieter mode.

q: How to remove the water tank with the Dreame D10s Pro?
a: Press the two side clips inwards and slide the water tank backward to separate it from the robot.

q: How to restore to factory settings with Dreame D10 Plus?
a: A: If D10 Plus still fails to operate normally after restarting, press and hold the reset button with a tool until hearing the voice prompt “start to restore factory settings.”

q: How to start cleaning with the Dreame D10 Plus?
a: Press the power button, it will start cleaning. Press any button during the cleaning, and it will pause. Note: Dreame D10 Plus will fail to work when the battery is too low. Please charge before using. If the completed cleaning duration is less than 10 minutes, the Dreame D10 Plus will do the cleaning twice by default.

q: How to use the Do-Not-Disturb mode with D10 Plus?
a: DND mode is enabled by default from 10:00 pm to 08:00 am. You can disable or edit DND mode with the Mi Home or Dreamehome app. D10 Plus will stop cleaning and voice reporting during the DND period, and the power indicator is off.

q: What does Dreame feature?
a: Equipped with multiple high-precision motion sensors, Dreame D10s robot also features vision positioning and navigation algorithms to accurately record movements and build maps. Highly adaptive to complicated home environment, the robot can also detect and across obstacles, and return for charging automatically. In terms of cleaning, it uses a front brush for sweeping and a rear wet-pad for mopping. A powerful suction and intelligent water tank are designed for a better cleaning result. Cleaning map is viewable in Dreamehome app at any time, allowing users to set cleaning time, switch operation modes, and clean the whole space with ease.

q: What is the max height of obstacles D10 Plus can cross?
a: The D10 Plus can cross obstacles up to 20mm high, shorter with the water tank installed. The max obstacle height will also decrease when D10 Plus is working on the slippery floor.

q: What should I do if the robot vacuum fails to avoid obstacles during the cleaning?
a: 1. Wipe the LDS sensor with a soft dry cloth and try to restart the device to check if it can work properly. The sensor might be clouded by dirt. 2.If the robot vacuum is connected to the network and is online, open the APP and click … on the upper right corner to check if the obstacle avoidance is off. Switch it on if it is off and restart the machine to check if it can work properly. 3.Make sure if the APP has the latest version. We suggest keeping the APP up to date ensure a better cleaning experience.

q: What should I do if the top cover of the water tank leaks?
a: The top cover of the water tank has a vent hole to balance the air pressure inside and outside the water tank. After filling water, level the water tank level during installation. Slight leakage is normal if the water tank is tilted during removing and installing.

q: What should I pay attention to before cleaning with Dreame D10 Plus?
a: Make sure the D10 Plus is fully charged before cleaning. Tidy up the space, put away fragile items and objects on the floor before cleaning.

q: Why do I fail to install the mop pad properly?
a: Align the mop pad with the module before installation.

q: Why do I smell the odor from the mop and dust compartment?
a: Odor is caused by the dirty mop that is not washed in time after cleaning. Please clean the rag in time after mopping the floor. The dust bin may also emit odor with liquid getting inside. Please clean the dust bin in time after cleaning.

q: Why does D10 Plus fail to decelerate when meeting the obstacles?
a: With the LDS Sensor, the D10 Plus could detect the obstacles and decelerate. However, for dark table legs or short barriers, it might be unable to detect and decelerate.

q: Why does D10 Plus fail to return to the Base?
a: 1.Check if there are too many obstacles around the Base. Put the Base in an open area free of obstacles within 0.5 m on both sides and 1.5 meters in front of the Base. 2.If D10 Plus does not start from the Base for cleaning, it may fail to find the Base after finishing up. Therefore, please ensure D10 Plus starts cleaning from the Base. 3.Moving D10 Plus to an uncleaned area will cause repositioning failure. In this case, restart the task.

q: Why does D10s Pro fail to reposition itself？
a:
Moving the robot to an uncleaned area will cause repositioning failure. Ensure D10s Pro is moved to a cleaned area. 
If a person is standing next to the D10s Pro, it will fail to reposition itself. 
Do not stand next to D10s Pro and ensure the camera has full access to all feature points in the room.
D10s Pro may fail to reposition itself in low lights. Please ensure sufficient light for repositioning.

q: Why does D10s Pro start to clean the next zone before finishing the current one?
a: After the first mapping, Dreame D10s Pro will clean your home by room. If this issue occurs, check the zone settings in the app and adjust the settings if any errors arise.

q: Why does the D10 Plus fail to avoid some obstacles？
a: To improve the cleaning performance, it is suggested to clean items such as threads/rags/slippers on the floor in advance.

q: Why does the robot fail to react when operating from the base？
a: When the robot is too far from the base, it will lose the connection. It will automatically connect back when the signal strength is stable.

q: Why does the robot fail to squirt water or operate with little water during mopping?
a:
Check the current water level in the water tank, install the mop properly according to instructions, and clean the mop in time.
Before mopping, please wet the pad for a better mopping experience before the robot squirts water.

q: Why does the robot keep connecting to the base after returning to charge?
a: Please check whether the charging interfaces of the base and the robot are with dust. Please clean the dust before using the system.

q: Why does the robot make a strange noise？
a: The main brush, side brush, or main wheels may be entangled with hair or debris. Turn off the robot and clean it.

q: Why is the floor still dirty after mopping?
a: Wash the mop pad in time when mopping on the dirty floor.

q: Will the cleaning efficacy drop when cleaning a complicated environment?
a: The Dreame D10 Plus will clean all corners in your home to ensure complete coverage. D10 Plus turns to make more turns and vacuums along the edges in a complex environment, resulting in decreased efficiency.

q: How to connect robot with Dreamehome or Dreamehome App?
a: 1. Scan the QR code on the robot, or search " Dreamehome" in the app store to download and install the app. 2. Add Device Open the Dreamehome app, tap "+" in the upper right, and scan the QR code above again to add "DreameBot D10s". Please follow the prompts to finish the Wi-Fi connection. 3. Reset Wi-Fi Simultaneously press and hold the buttons and until you hear a voice prompt saying, “Waiting for the network configuration.” Once the Wi-Fi indicator is blinking slowly, the Wi-Fi has been successfully reset. Note: If your robot cannot connect to the app successfully, reset the Wi-Fi and add the device again.

q: Why does Dreamehome/Dreamehome App indicates that the robot is offline？
a: Please make sure the robot is turned on and the Wi-Fi connection is stable. During the cleaning, the robot might be offline when the Wi-Fi network connection is weak in some areas. It will be back online automatically when the Wi-Fi signal is strong.

q: A collision occurs after AI function is ON.
a:
1. Function Introduction: AI recognition function can keep your house tidy and clean, and prevent your robot from being entangled or trapped. For more cleaning areas, your robot will be as close to the obstacle as possible while avoiding the obstacle, so a gentle collision of your robot with the obstacle is normal.
2. Complex Environment: If the home environment is complex, or the shape of the obstacle is special, the AI recognition will take more time, causing a collision. 
3. Low Light: Low light conditions may cause an unsatisfying AI recognition performance. It is recommended to use this function in a well-lit environment.

q: An unpleasant order occurs to the mop pad.
a:
An Unpleasant Odor of Mop Pad:
1. Causes: Your home is humid, or the mop pad is not dry and goes moldy.
2. Daily Use: It is recommended to use the floor cleaner to wash the mop pad to reduce the possibility of mildew.
3. Storage: Remove the mop pad and dry it in a well-ventilated environment.

q: Do I need to put away carpets when mopping?
a:
1. No-Go Zones: Before mopping, you can set the area where the carpet is located as the no-go zone in the Map Management section, and the robot will avoid the carpet while cleaning.
2. Organizing Your Home: If the carpet is placed at the door of the room and you want your robot to clean this room, you need to put away the carpet in advance.

q: How to set a customized cleaning?
a:
1. Open the homepage of the plug-in, enter the Customized Cleaning section via Cleaning Settings > Customized Cleaning > Settings.
2. Manual Setup: In the Customized Setting section, you can select different areas to have personalized settings including the suction, humidity of mop pad, cleaning times, etc.
3. Intelligent Recommendation: Tap the "Intelligent Recommendation" button in the Customized Setting section, the personalized cleaning patterns will be generated according to room types.
4. Save Settings: Tap "√" in the top right-hand corner to save your settings.

q: I want to reset the system or all settings.
a:
1. When the button is malfunctioning or you cannot turn off your robot, open the upper cover of your robot, press the Reset button, and your robot will restart automatically.
2. Note: The system reset will clear all scheduled cleaning tasks and cleaning modes, and delete the Wi-Fi network connections.

q: I want to schedule a cleaning.
a:
1. Enter the plug-in homepage, tap Settings (top right) > Scheduled Cleaning > Add (lower right) in turn.
2. You can set the parameters in advance including Cleaning Range, Starting Time, and Repeat.
3. Tap "√" in the top right-hand corner to save your settings, and the cleaning is scheduled.

q: I want to share my robot with others.
a:
1. Your robot has connected to the Wi-Fi network.
2. Please confirm that the user to be shared with has signed up in the Dreamehome App. 
3. Open My Devices page , click "···" and select "Device Sharing" to share the device to other Dreamehome users. 
4. Enter the shared user's Dreame ID/Phone Number/Email used for registration. Once they have accepted the robot, they can also control it.

q: I want to update the firmware.
a:
1. Make sure the robot is being charged and turned on.
2. Make sure your home Wi-Fi network is stable.
3. Update the firmware via Settings > Firmware Update.
4. While updating, the lights on the robot will blink.
5. The firmware will not update unless the battery level is over 15%.

q: I want to work with Amazon Alexa.

q: Is the filter washable?
a:
1. The filter can be washed with water manually and needs to be thoroughly dry before re-installing.
2. It is recommended to dry the filter for at least 24 hours after washing it.

q: Place the robot to the specific area and start cleaning.
a:
1. Mapping: During the first-time mapping or re-mapping, do NOT move your robot in case the mapping FAILS.
2. Map Coverage: If the area to be cleaned is not mapped, the robot cannot clean this area even if you put your robot in this area.
3. Normal Cleaning: If the area to be cleaned is mapped, you can put your robot in this area and start cleaning.

q: Resume cleaning is not performed.
a:
1. Check to ensure that the resume cleaning function is enabled.
2. The resume cleaning function cannot be enabled in DND (Do Not Disturb) mode.
3. Check whether a fault message is triggered on the App when the robot is charging. If there is a fault, the resume cleaning function will not be enabled.
4. Check whether your robot is restarted or reset after enabling the resume cleaning function.

q: The brush is entangled.
a:
1. Remove the brush cover, take out the brush, and clean the foreign objects on the brush.
2. Re-install the brush after cleaning, rotate it by hand to check whether it works smoothly.
3. Make sure the brush cover clicks in place when re-installing.

q: The cleaning paths are disordered.
a:
First-time Mapping
While mapping,  the paths will be so disordered that your robot can learn the environment as much as possible. Once the map is saved, the cleaning paths will be clearer. 

After Maps Saved
If the cleaning paths of your robot are in a jumble, please check the following:
1. Before Cleaning: Tidy up the scattered items on the floor such as power strips, toys, slippers, etc., to avoid frequent collisions and chaotic cleaning paths. 
2. While Cleaning: If the wheels are covered with dirt or oil, or get trapped by foreign objects, clean the wheels to ensure the robot moves normally.
3. While Cleaning: If the robot collides with objects many times while cleaning, it will clean along edges and walls briefly and then resume an S-shaped cleaning pattern.
4. Recurrence: If the cleaning paths are disordered, update the firmware to the latest version, reset maps, and map your house again.
5. For the robot with a ToF sensor, you can wipe the ToF sensor.

q: The current cleaning task is paused unexpectedly.
a:
1. The robot enters the sleeping mode after being trapped for a period of time.
2. The robot will run out of its battery and turn off automatically if it fails to charge its battery. The causes may be that the base is NOT powered on, or the robot and base are NOT connected.
3. An exception may occur to the system, please contact customer service.

q: The house map is incomplete or some areas are missing while mapping.
a:
Causes for Incomplete Maps:
1. There are items at the door of the room, or the door of the room is not fully open. When your robot scans the entrance, it will misjudge that it cannot pass and avoid this area.
2. When the robot is scanning and mapping, people or pets walking around the robot will mislead the scanning and result in incomplete map creation.

q: The maps are lost or overlapping.
a:
1. If the robot starts cleaning after being moved, it will perform self-positioning. Once the self-positioning fails, the robot will re-create the map and the current map will be covered.
2. If the robot is trapped or slips, some zones on the map may overlap. Please re-map the areas to be cleaned or restore the map.

q: The maps are not saved/updated.
a:
1. While mapping, the robot will learn and map your home environment, and return to the dock/base. The map will not be saved unless the voice prompts that the mapping is completed.
2. If the robot is moved back to the dock/base while mapping, or the mapping is interrupted, the maps will not be saved or updated.

q: The robot cannot charge.
a:
1. The dock/base is NOT powered on. Make sure both ends of the power cord of your dock/base are plugged in.
2. The charging contacts on the dock/base are in poor contact with those on your robot. Power off and clean the charging contacts, or adjust their positions.

q: The robot cannot dock.
a:
Causes for Docking Failure:
1. The dock/base is powered off or moved. Power it on and put it back.
2. There are some obstacles around the dock/base. Clear the obstacles.
3. Your robot is trapped while cleaning. Place it onto the dock/base.
4. The dock/base is NOT on a flat surface. Put it on a flat surface.
5. System error. Place the robot 1 meter in front of the dock/base, and tap the "Recall" button. If the robot cannot return to the dock/base, please contact customer service.

q: The robot cannot turn on.
a:
Causes for NOT Turning On:
1. System error, and the button is malfunctioning.
2. The robot cannot be turned on if it has a low battery. Put your robot onto the base/dock and charge it for a while, and turn it on.
3. If the robot still cannot be turned on after charging, reset all settings. If the issue remains unsolved, please contact customer service.

q: The robot cannot update the firmware.
a:
Causes of Firmware Update Failure:
1. Low battery. The firmware cannot be updated if the battery level is lower than 15%.
2. Weak Wi-Fi signal or out of the Wi-Fi range. If your robot is located in a weak Wi-Fi signal area or out of the Wi-Fi range, it may cause an update failure. Make sure both your robot and the dock/base are in a good Wi-Fi range.

q: The robot cleans an area repeatedly.
a:
1. If the cleaning time is less than 10 minutes, the robot will perform the cleaning task again. (except for selected-room cleaning)
2. If some zones are overlapping on the map, the robot may fail to self-position and miss some areas while cleaning. If so, re-map the areas to be cleaned or restore the map.

q: The robot does not clean automatically at the scheduled time.
a: Your robot may have a low battery. The scheduled cleaning will not start unless the battery level is over 15%.

q: The robot does not continue cleaning after recharging.
a:
1. Your robot may be in the DND (Do Not Disturb) mode, in which it will not resume cleaning.
2. If you return your robot to the dock or recharge your robot manually, it will not resume cleaning.

q: The robot does not resume cleaning.
a:
1. The robot may be set to the Do Not Disturb (DND) mode, which will prevent it from resuming cleaning.
2. The robot does not resume cleaning when it is manually recharged or placed onto the base.

q: The robot fails to rechage.
a:
1. There may be too many obstacles around the dock/base. Clear the obstacles or place the dock/base in an open area.
2. Your robot may be too far away from the dock. Place your robot near the dock.
3. While cleaning, ensure your robot sets out from the base/dock to make the location of the base/dock accurate in the map.
4. Make sure the base or the base station is powered on.
5. Check whether the in-app maps are askew or overlapping. If so, recreate maps.

q: The robot is malfunctioning.
a:
Try the Following:
1. Restart your robot.
2. If the issue remains unsolved, reset the system.

q: The robot is offline after connecting to the network.
a:
1. Check your network connection.
2. While cleaning, the robot will be offline when it is in poor Wi-Fi coverage.
3. The robot will be offline when it is not onto the base and runs out of its battery.

q: The robot makes a strange noise while cleaning.
a:
1. A strange noise will sound while cleaning if the brush is entangled. Remove the brush, clear the foreign objects, and reinstall the brush.
2. Restart your robot after installing the brush to check whether the noise disappears.
3. If the strange noise remains, check the brush again or contact customer service.

q: The robot misses an area.
a:
1. The robot cannot enter the narrow space unless it is 2 cm wider than both sides of the robot.
2. For the robot with the ultrasonic sensor, it can recognize the carpet at the door and will not enter this room while mopping. Please remove the carpet.
3. If some zones are overlapping on the map, the robot may fail to self-position and miss some areas while cleaning. If so, re-map the areas to be cleaned or restore the map.
4. If there is a high pile carpet or wires at the entrance of the area to be cleaned, the robot with the obstacle avoidance function will avoid this area. Please tidy up the items on the floor before operating the robot.

q: The robot with AI function cannot recognize objects.
a:
1. Turn On: Make sure the AI Recognition function is ON.
2. Recognizable Objects: Only shoes (slippers), socks, rags, wires, bathroom scales, bases can be recognized in the current version.
3. Normal Part: Your robot will slow down and collide with the obstacle, or avoid the obstacle due to the obstacle avoidance algorithm. A gentle collision of your robot with the obstacle is normal.
4. Low Light: Low light conditions may cause an unsatisfying AI recognition performance. It is recommended to use this function in a well-lit environment. 
5. Complex Environment: If the home environment is complex, or the shape of the obstacle is special, the AI recognition process will take more time, causing a collision. 
6. Dirty Lens:  Dirty lens may have an impact on object recognition. Please wipe the camera lens with a clean cloth and keep them clean.
7. Firmware OTA:  OTA (Over The Air) technology will help you update the firmware to the latest version. Please check regularly in case of not missing any performance improvements.

q: The suction power sounds weaker or the cleaning performance seems to degrade recently.
a:
1. The dust bin is full and needs to be cleaned. The auto-empty base will empty the bin automatically, you have no issues with it.
2. The filter is clogged and needs to be cleaned.
3. The main brush is entangled and needs to be cleaned.
4. The suction level is low and needs to be switched to a higher suction level.

q: Can the robot operate in the low-light environment?
a: Yes, the LDS laser sensor is not affected by light. But the obstacle avoidance effect will be affected, recomended as far as possible in the case of sufficient light.

q: Does Dreame D10s Pro have any consumables that require maintenance regularly?
a:
Consumables Suggested Maintenance
Main Brush Clean weekly and replace every 6-12 months
Filter Clean weekly and replace every 3-6 months
Side Brush Clean weekly and replace every 3-6 months
Mop Wash after the cleaning and replace every 3-6 months

q: How long does it take to charge the robot fully?
a: It is about 6 hours

q: How to clean a multi-floor house?
a:
Move the robot to the floor to be cleaned and select the corresponding map to start cleaning. If this floor is cleaned for the first time, you need to create a map first by tapping Map Management > Create > Save on the plugin homepage. 

Note: For the robot with self-cleaning function (Model W10/W10 Pro), if you want the robot to do the self-cleaning, you can move the self-wash base to the same floor as the robot. Otherwise, please turn off the self-cleaning function.

q: The mop pad is too wet, or there is too much water in the fresh tank.
a:
Too Much Water in Fresh Tank:
If the local environment is relatively humid, or the water stains are not easy to dry on indoor floors, you can select a water volume for the water tank via Water Volume Settings > Low.

q: The robot moves around after setting out from the base.
a: After your robot sets out from the base, it will do self-locating and self-checking first. So your robot may turn around in place.

q: Why does the robot fail to resume cleaning after recharging itself?
a: Make sure the robot is not working in the DND Mode. If you actively command it to return or manually move it back to the dock, D10s Pro will not resume cleaning either.

q: Can Dreame D10 Plus clean narrow spaces?
a: The minimum width for D10 Plus to pass through is 38 cm. Any spaces narrower than this number are not available for D10 Plus to clean.
